mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Portsmouth Mental Health Hub
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Local advisers help people find the right mental health support in Portsmouth, including when they are concerned about someone else. The hub is for people aged 16 and over; see its site for current hours.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Talking Therapies Portsmouth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: NHS practitioners help people manage difficulties such as depression, anxiety, panic and phobias. The service offers guided self-help, groups and talking therapies. Visit the service page for access and referrals.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Kooth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Free online wellbeing support for eligible young people, with counsellor messaging, moderated discussions, journalling and self-help. Check the website for availability in your area.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: HIVE Portsmouth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: A community network and helpdesk connecting people with local charities, voluntary organisations and practical support.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Reading Well – Books on Prescription
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Recommended self-help books on common health and wellbeing topics. Find the reading lists online or ask at your local library.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Mindfulness
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: These resources offer guided mindfulness exercises and ways to practise noticing thoughts and feelings. Check providers for access and prices.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Positive Minds – Solent Mind
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: The PDF’s Positive Minds entry describes local peer support. Solent Mind now directs Portsmouth residents to its Community Peer Service and explains the current referral route on its service page.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Solent Recovery College
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: The former Solent Recovery College is now part of the Hampshire and Isle of Wight Wellbeing & Recovery College, offering online and in-person courses. Enrol before booking a course.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Mind
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Information and practical support for people experiencing mental health difficulties, including signposting to local services.

veterans-support.title: Veterans Outreach Support (VOS)
veterans-support.description: Wellbeing, welfare and mental health support for veterans and their families, with a Portsmouth office at the Royal Maritime Hotel. Check with the provider for drop-in and referral information.

elderly-support.title: Remind
elderly-support.description: A Solent Mind service offering practical help and activities for people with dementia and their carers in Portsmouth. See the provider for eligibility and referral options.

elderly-support.title: Age UK (Portsmouth)
elderly-support.description: Local services, information and activities for older people and those supporting them.

relationship-support.title: Relate
relationship-support.description: Counselling, information and support for relationships, including couples and families.

bereavement.title: Cruse Bereavement Support
bereavement.description: Emotional support and information for people grieving after a death, with routes to local, one-to-one and group support.

bereavement.title: Bereavement Support Groups
bereavement.description: The Bereavement Care service offers practical and emotional support after a loss, including one-to-one support and groups.

citizens-advice.title: Citizens Advice
citizens-advice.description: Free and independent advice on benefits, work, debt, housing, consumer rights and other practical problems. Use the Portsmouth office for local advice and the national site for information.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: PARCS (Portsmouth Abuse and Rape Counselling)
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Specialist counselling and support for people affected by sexual violence or domestic abuse in Portsmouth and South East Hampshire. The office handles counselling enquiries and referrals. PARCS no longer runs the dedicated helpline listed in the PDF.

contacts.label: Family Action PARCS service and referrals

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Hampshire Domestic Abuse Partnership
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Information and an advice line for people affected by domestic abuse, their families and professionals in Hampshire.

contacts.label: Hampshire County Council domestic abuse support

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Stop Domestic Abuse (Portsmouth)
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Specialist local support and confidential advice for people affected by domestic abuse or stalking.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Aurora New Dawn
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Advocacy and support for people affected by domestic abuse, sexual violence or stalking. The service enquiries line is not an emergency line.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Yellow Door (Southampton)
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Southampton-based support and specialist services for people affected by domestic abuse, sexual violence and other interpersonal harm.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: YouTrust – Paragon Hampshire
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Practical and emotional support for people affected by domestic abuse, sexual violence or stalking. These contact details are for the Hampshire team.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: National Domestic Abuse Helpline
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Refuge provides confidential information and support for women experiencing domestic abuse in England.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Men’s Advice Line
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Advice and emotional support for men affected by domestic abuse, including information for people supporting them.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: National LGBT+ Domestic Abuse Helpline
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Galop offers support for LGBT+ people affected by abuse or violence, including domestic abuse.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Childline
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Confidential support for children and young people experiencing domestic abuse or worried about relationships at home.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Lifestyle Wellbeing
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Support for making changes around smoking, alcohol, activity and healthy weight. NHS Better Health replaces older One You resources, and Portsmouth lists local options.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Wellbeing Service
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Free Portsmouth support to stop smoking, drink less alcohol, get active or work towards a healthy weight.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: NHS Smokefree
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: NHS information, tools and routes to support for people who want to stop smoking.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Safer Portsmouth
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Portsmouth City Council’s current alcohol guide explains risks and where to get local help. It is a more direct route than the number in the original PDF.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Portsmouth Recovery Hub and FRANK
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: The local Recovery Hub helps people access drug and alcohol services. FRANK is a separate national drug-information service. Use the contact route that matches the support you need.

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Cancer Support
end-of-life-support.description: Practical, emotional and financial information and support for people affected by cancer and those close to them.

end-of-life-support.title: Cancer Research UK
end-of-life-support.description: Information about cancer and treatment, including access to specialist cancer information nurses.

contacts.label: Cancer Research UK: ask the nurses

end-of-life-support.title: Harbour Cancer Support
end-of-life-support.description: A Gosport centre offering practical and emotional support to people affected by cancer, including friends, relatives and carers. The centre is at 2 Stoke Road, Gosport, PO12 1JB.

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Cancer Information and Support Service – Queen Alexandra Hospital
end-of-life-support.description: Support for people affected by cancer, their families, friends and carers. The hospital centre offers a place to talk and helps people find information and practical support.

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Cancer Information and Support Service – Chichester
end-of-life-support.description: The Macmillan Information Hub at St Richard’s Hospital offers cancer information, emotional support and signposting to financial and other practical help.

end-of-life-support.title: Wessex Cancer Support
end-of-life-support.description: Previously Wessex Cancer Trust. The charity offers emotional and practical support to people affected by cancer. Check its current centre list rather than relying on the older Cosham listing.

contacts.label: Current Wessex Cancer Support contact details

end-of-life-support.title: Dying Matters
end-of-life-support.description: Hospice UK resources for conversations about dying and grief, plus a directory of hospice care.

end-of-life-support.title: Countess Mountbatten
end-of-life-support.description: Now Mountbatten Hampshire. The hospice offers specialist care and support for people with life-limiting illnesses and their families in the Southampton area.

end-of-life-support.title: Rowans Hospice
end-of-life-support.description: Palliative and hospice services for people with life-limiting illnesses and their families in Portsmouth and South East Hampshire. Check the access route for each service.

end-of-life-support.title: St Wilfrid’s Chichester
end-of-life-support.description: Palliative care and family support in and around Chichester, including hospice care at home. The current hospice site is in Bosham.

end-of-life-support.title: The Rosemary Foundation
end-of-life-support.description: Hospice-at-home nursing, emotional support and bereavement services in Petersfield and surrounding areas. Use the public office for general enquiries.

paediatrics.title: Hampshire Specialist CAMHS
paediatrics.description: Specialist mental health services for children and young people. Hampshire and Portsmouth have separate referral routes; use the provider page for your area.

paediatrics.title: Barnardo’s Hampshire Specialist Parenting Support Service
paediatrics.description: The PDF lists a Barnardo’s parenting support service. Use the current service finder to check the support available near you, as the original service link could not be confirmed.

contacts.label: Barnardo’s support for parents and carers

paediatrics.title: Catch 22
paediatrics.description: Catch22’s Hampshire 24/7 service supports eligible young people and families affected by substance use. Visit the service page for local coverage and referral information.

paediatrics.title: Hampshire Youth Access
paediatrics.description: Therapeutic and wellbeing support for children and young people. The provider explains eligibility and referral rules for each locality.

paediatrics.title: Simon Says (Bereavement)
paediatrics.description: Hampshire support for children and young people affected by the death or serious illness of someone important to them.

paediatrics.title: Childline
paediatrics.description: Confidential support for children and young people facing bullying, abuse, problems at home or other worries.

paediatrics.title: The Mix
paediatrics.description: Online information and support for people under 25, covering topics including mental health, relationships and money. Check the provider’s site for current ways to get support.

paediatrics.title: Anxiety UK
paediatrics.description: Resources and support for people experiencing anxiety, including young people and those supporting them. See the provider’s current contact options.

paediatrics.title: Anna Freud National Centre for Children and Families
paediatrics.description: Mental health and wellbeing resources for children, young people, parents, carers and professionals.

paediatrics.title: Young Minds
paediatrics.description: Information for young people with mental health concerns and advice for parents and carers. The Parents Helpline is not a crisis service.

contacts.label: Parents and carers advice (not a crisis service): 0808 802 5544

paediatrics.title: No Panic
paediatrics.description: Information and support for people affected by panic attacks, phobias and anxiety, including advice for people supporting them.

paediatrics.title: Mental Health Support Teams (MHST)
paediatrics.description: Mental Health Support Teams work through Portsmouth schools. Families can ask their school about the support available and how to make a referral.

contacts.label: Portsmouth City Council school support guidance

paediatrics.title: Kooth.com
paediatrics.description: Online emotional wellbeing support for eligible young people, including moderated peer support, counselling and self-help resources. Check eligibility and register on the website.

paediatrics.title: Talking Change Portsmouth
paediatrics.description: Now NHS Talking Therapies Portsmouth. The service supports eligible people aged 16 and over who are registered with a Portsmouth GP, and accepts self-referrals.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: NHS Urgent Mental Health Support
mental-health-in-crisis.description: The NHS explains the options for urgent mental health support in England and what to do in a mental health emergency.

contacts.label: NHS: where to get urgent help

mental-health-in-crisis.title: Samaritans
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Confidential listening support for anyone going through a difficult time. Read the provider’s page for current ways to make contact.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: SHOUT
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Text-based mental health support in the UK. The provider explains how to start a conversation and how the service works.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: CALM (Campaign Against Living Miserably)
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Support and information for people who are struggling or worried about someone else. Check CALM’s website for current contact options.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: Stay Alive App
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Suicide prevention resources and safety-planning tools. The app is not a substitute for urgent professional help.

other-resources.title: Patient.info
other-resources.description: Health information for patients and the public, including resources on mental health and wellbeing.

other-resources.title: NHS Moodzone
other-resources.description: The NHS offers current resources for mental wellbeing, sleep, stress and low mood through Every Mind Matters.

other-resources.title: Moodjuice
other-resources.description: NHS inform now hosts online self-help guides for topics including anxiety, low mood and grief, replacing the legacy Moodjuice route.

other-resources.title: Calm App
other-resources.description: A breathing exercise from Calm’s wellbeing reference material.

other-resources.title: Facing Your Feelings
other-resources.description: A self-help workbook from the Centre for Clinical Interventions on coping with difficult emotions.

contacts.label: Facing Your Feelings: distress tolerance resources

other-resources.title: Psychology Tools
other-resources.description: Anxiety information and self-help resources. Check the provider for which resources are freely available.

other-resources.title: Centre for Clinical Interventions
other-resources.description: Public mental health information sheets and self-help workbooks from Western Australia’s Centre for Clinical Interventions.

contacts.label: Centre for Clinical Interventions self-help resources

other-resources.title: Solent NHS YouTube Channel
other-resources.description: Public videos are available on the channel for the NHS trust that now includes former Solent NHS services.

contacts.label: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS videos
